purpose: R261 quality-relative strength plus low-lottery-demand weakest-link factor versus the matched R257 control

universe.industry_source: current ext_hy_ths industry snapshot; not historical PIT

factor.formula: quality_low_lottery_min_rank = min(rank_pct(quality_relative_strength_min_rank), rank_pct(-max_ret_20d)) within historical nonfinancial HS300 members
factor.pit_rule: R257 uses information observable on the same trading date; max_ret_20d uses front-adjusted close-to-close daily returns over the current and prior 19 trading days; same-date component ranks and minimum only; both components required

pit_audit.rule: same-date percentile rank of R257 quality-relative strength and negative 20-day maximum single-day return within historical nonfinancial HS300 members; take the minimum of the two percentile ranks; both required
pit_audit.rank_normalization: rank_pct = (number_of_names - descending_average_rank) / (number_of_names - 1); 1 is best and 0 is worst

samples.rolling_1y: 252-trading-day rolling compounded return over the stitched 2023-2026 curve
samples.recent_12m: last 252 trading-day returns of the stitched 2023-2026 curve

execution.cost_stress: 4x and 5x scale all four components proportionally
execution.stitching: two segment returns compounded into one curve; first day of each later segment skipped

caveats: The maximum daily return component is sensitive to a single outlier and can discard persistent trend winners.
The minimum of two percentile ranks can be sparse and sensitive to ties.
R253, industry-relative strength and lottery-demand measures were researched in overlapping samples, so multiple-comparison risk remains.
The low-lottery component has moderate correlation with R249 low skew, so shared behavioral exposure remains.
The industry snapshot used to exclude financials is current rather than historical PIT.
Financial values inherit provider restatement and publication-timing risk.
The full curve is stitched from two system-engine segments; segment boundaries can reset an open position.
Trade P&L shares are contribution diagnostics from two segments each starting at 1,000,000 notional.
Passing every gate would justify paper-trading validation, not production deployment.
